sourceEvidence.description: Published/indexed Le Français Simple 1 content lists Units 1–6 and their vocabulary/grammar/cahier sections, including Units 4–6.
Annual distribution places Units 1–3 before the first-semester exam and Units 4–6 in the second semester, followed by the end-of-year exam.
External material explicitly labels Unit 4 Les nationalités as Le Français Simple 1, first preparatory, second semester; used for cross-checking only.

designRule: The readiness pack must cover the complete previous academic year. Current-year/next-grade content is used only to determine prerequisite importance, not to replace previous-year source content.
qualityRule: External general French books such as Bravo/Génial may enrich exercise formats and language practice, but cannot introduce unsupported curriculum topics into the prerequisite map.
